reason: I buy to resell, so 13,000 a kilo by air plus 8% kills my margin on car parts and accessories; my cargo agent ships by the carton much cheaper and I can still beat that in Shorja. This is built for one pair of shoes, not for a shop.
objection: Landed cost per piece is too high for resale, and if half a batch is fake or doesn't work I only get money back for damaged or wrong items, maybe after weeks of arguing, while my shelf sits empty.
would_change_my_mind: A wholesale rate for bulk 1688 orders: lower per-kilo price or sea/land cargo option, a reduced buying fee above a certain order size, and the warehouse actually testing items before shipping.
